summary: Declare the existing Goal publisher for periodic release observation

delivery.outcome: Explicitly opt the existing Goal PyPI publisher into periodic read-only release observation.
nonGoals: No registry adapter or publisher transport change
No runtime package version or dependencies change
No ticket, source admission or CI bypass

architecture.decision: The observer requires explicit publishing.enabled while the historical Goal publisher defaults to enabled. Add the exact declaration enabled=true and registries=[pypi] in the already-governed configuration; preserve every existing semantic setting. Existing service watch already includes this primary. This is configuration-only observation adoption, not a package release.
architecture.rollback: Independent protected revert of the explicit observation declaration.

commands: Published observer recognizes the exact existing registry release while retaining typed unknown for unsupported source layout
Existing adoption regression and governed Goal source delivery
Live primary readback recognizes the existing release; unsupported source-layout verification remains explicit unknown
